subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: Should strict unclosed reasoning recovery prefer a later `<final>` boundary or drop hidden content instead of returning everything after the opening reasoning tag?
rationale: The current fallback is intentionally recovering malformed answers, but the reported shape turns that recovery into hidden-reasoning exposure, so the permanent strict-mode behavior needs owner/security judgment.

options.title: Recover final body in shared sanitizer
options.body: Detect a well-formed later `<final>` block after an unclosed reasoning opener and deliver only that final body, then add shared and channel regression proof.

options.title: Drop malformed unclosed reasoning entirely
options.body: Prefer preventing hidden reasoning exposure even if malformed local-model replies sometimes become empty.

options.title: Keep fallback and fix channels individually
options.body: Leave strict recovery unchanged and require each affected channel or stream parser to suppress malformed tagged reasoning before delivery.

recommendation.title: Recover final body in shared sanitizer
recommendation.body: Detect a well-formed later `<final>` block after an unclosed reasoning opener and deliver only that final body, then add shared and channel regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared sanitizer and final-tag behavior history points most directly to this owner for the strict-mode semantics decision.
